summary: V6.25.58 — Featured Starter Campaigns: ALL GREEN. 7/7 starter pytest tests pass; 24/24 regression (Phase B/D/E/F: cosmology, campaign-export, gm-voice, bestiary) still green. Public endpoints work without auth: GET /api/public/starters returns the seeded Evereantha row (slug=evereantha-the-maiden-adventure-starter, featured=true, bytes=702055, stats include 538 nodes/23 chars/8 sessions). GET /api/public/starters/{slug}/download streams .tgcampaign.json with Content-Disposition + X-TG-Bundle-Schema=1 + valid schema_version=1 bundle, increments downloads counter (verified 0→1→2). 404 returned for unknown slug. Frontend: landing-starter-campaigns section visible on /, /landing, and /discover (no login); starter-grid, starter-card-evereantha-..., starter-featured-... (Crown badge), starter-system-... ('BESM 4E'), and starter-download-... all present and wired. Clicking Download actually fires a browser-level download with correct suggested_filename. Admin /app/admin shows 'STARTER CAMPAIGNS' tab; clicking renders admin-starters-panel with all expected form inputs (source-select, title, blurb, blurb-long, featured-check, publish-btn) and admin-starter-list with admin-starter-row-evereantha-... featuring star toggle + Delete action. No 'Compiled with problems' overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/starters.py — sort key uses `-((created_at or '')).__hash__()` for tie-breaking — hash of strings is non-deterministic across Python processes since PYTHONHASHSEED is random by default. Replace with sort by created_at descending using the iso string directly (since iso strings are lexicographically sortable) for deterministic ordering.

routes/starters.py — _persist_starter race condition: the slug uniqueness loop (`while find_one(... slug)`) is not atomic with the subsequent insert_one. Two concurrent admin uploads with the same title could both pass the check and both insert the same slug. Add a unique index on starter_campaigns.slug at startup, and retry-on-DuplicateKeyError to make it race-safe.

routes/starters.py — upload_starter accepts any UploadFile with no Content-Type or file-extension guard; only checks JSON parseability. Consider also asserting bundle.get('schema_version') matches EXPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION to avoid storing future-incompatible bundles.

StarterCampaigns.jsx — `r.featured` cards are rendered with a Crown but the section heading doesn't differentiate; consider an explicit 'Featured' rail above 'All starters' for better visual hierarchy as the gallery grows (cosmetic, not blocking).
